_doc: lookout: from-scratch 1v1 hero-sized hybrid transformer (2 conv blocks + 3 attention blocks, width 128, network.init attention) on the real 2.17.3 rules, obs v3 (opponent history), Daytona 4x RTX PRO 6000 learner + GPU-inference actors. The game and PPO settings are farsight's (experiments/curio/configs/hero-1v1-scratch.json, 2026-11-01): no_peace, a capped game is a loss for both seats, omniscient critic, gamma .995 / turn clock .99. Platform knobs are main's Daytona set (send_thread off). lr_warmup_updates 200: a from-scratch transformer under PPO wants a linear LR warmup (attention logits at init are unstable at 3e-4 from step 0). training_seconds set at launch (hero.py run_config). serialize_gpu on (2026-11-01 smoke): the first 4-GPU collective hung with rank 0 never launched and three ranks waiting (the 4090-head signature the lock was added for); no measurable cost. value_sub 2048 + value_sub_two_seats: the value pass over 8192-row chunks holds [rows, heads, 196, 196] attention scores; sub-chunked for memory. stream_views off (2026-11-01, run): with the cuDNN attention kernel the 4-GPU learner deadlocked after update 1 (main thread in the training step, the assembler's DeviceRows page write blocked, GPU 0 idle and GPUs 1-3 spinning), the signature docs/platforms.md records for page streaming on the 4090 head.
